_README: Analyze-phase plan for acquia.com (real Drupal, non-SXA agnostic test). Deterministic pipeline: crawl -> semantic_extract -> group_llm(DeepSeek V4 Flash) -> assemble+partition-gate -> CND+views. Every step proven by a PROBE exiting 0. Run deterministically: python3 orchestration/run_local.py orchestration/plans/acquia-analyze.plan.json --from step_semantic  (crawl already cached). ns=acq mixns=acqmix.
goal: Analyze https://www.acquia.com into a stable Jahia component + template model (project acquia-drupal, namespace acq), CND-ready.

epics.title: Deterministic analyze
epics.goal: Crawl, extract candidates deterministically, group via DeepSeek (gate-verified), assemble manifest + CND.

steps.title: Localize assets -> self-contained local mirror (truly offline render, before the fidelity gate)
Bounded LLM grouping via DeepSeek V4 Flash (self-correcting, gate-clean)
acceptance_criteria: Run: python3 orchestration/lib/group_llm.py projects/acquia-drupal --model deepseek-v4-flash --ns acq --out projects/acquia-drupal/workflow-output/grouping.json --retries 4

steps.title: Emit CND + view plan (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Run: python3 orchestration/lib/cnd_emit.py projects/acquia-drupal/workflow-output/component-manifest.json --ns acq --mixns acqmix --project acquia-drupal --out-cnd projects/acquia-drupal/workflow-output/definitions.cnd --out-views projects/acquia-drupal/workflow-output/views.json

steps.title: Round-trip fidelity gate: reconstruct sample pages from extracted components and pixel-diff vs source (BEFORE templatization)
acceptance_criteria: Reconstructs YOUR chosen sample pages from ONLY the extracted component nodes, renders in a real browser, pixel-diffs against the live source, and writes a self-contained visual review at workflow-output/reconstruct/review.html (drag-slider source vs reconstruction + diff heatmap per page). GATE = content coverage (all editable text captured). Edit --pages to pick your sample (or use --all).
